summary: Prudential plc filed a Form 6-K announcing on-market share repurchases under a buyback programme with JP Morgan Securities plc. Between 27 and 31 July 2026, Prudential purchased 1,352,456 ordinary shares at a volume-weighted average price of approximately 11.04 GBP per share, reflecting prices from 10.7150 to 11.3700 GBP. Shares will be cancelled, reducing voting rights to 2,503,627,395. The programme launched 6 January 2026; cumulative purchases reach 50,319,574 shares. The buyback is structured as an on-exchange transaction under LSE Listing Rules and Hong Kong Share Buy-Backs Code. Watch for continued execution pace and capital-return impact on Prudential's ADR valuation.
